title: Skill directory manifest
description: Manifest describing how to submit skills, host plugins, or MCP servers to a public directory or catalog.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must match the YAML filename without extension.

description.description: What the directory lists and who it serves.

status.description: active = submit now; wait = blocked or queued; skip = do not target.

url.description: Submission or onboarding URL when applicable.

catalog_repo.description: GitHub owner/repo of the catalog repository, if any. Use gh/API only — never clone.

catalog_path.description: Path within the catalog repo for PR-based listings.

notes.description: Access caveats: org requirements, review gates, auth, etc.

listing_unit.description: What one listing card represents. Use plugin or product for bundled host plugins with 2+ first-party SKILL.md files.

splits_skills.description: When true, the directory imports a repo and may create one card per discovered SKILL.md. Skip unless the user opts into per-skill cards.

hosts.description: Agent hosts or ecosystems the directory primarily targets.

item_types.description: Component types accepted by the directory.

install_guidance.description: Recommended end-user install path (prefer host marketplace/plugin install).

proposal_fields.description: Fields to collect before proposing a submission.
